_sheet: The bodycam look. One row per effect; every number the camera code uses is here.

rows.what: Fisheye lens, vignette, colour fringing, grain and washed-out colour, as a post effect.
Wide chest-camera field of view; narrower while aiming.
Camera sits on the chest: lower than the eyes.
Body-mounted camera motion: idle breathing, step bob with roll, turn lag.
rows.verified: pending: needs a person walking and turning

rows.what: The gun moves inside a box before the camera turns, and shots go where the gun points.
rows.verified: pending: needs a person moving the mouse

rows.what: Shot kick on the camera and how fast it settles.
rows.verified: pending: seen in one screenshot only; needs a person

rows.what: No crosshair. Hotbar and status bars stay hidden and only peek in after a slot change or taking damage. A recording stamp in the corner.
rows.verified: in-game autotest 2026-10-07 (PASS) + screenshots (stamp shown, crosshair hidden)

rows.what: Where the gun sits in view, in metres from the camera: hip position of the gun origin, and how far the sights sit from the eye when aiming.
